title: Vector Competence Data Standard v1.0.0
description: A minimal flexible data standard viral vector competence studies

experimentID.description: A unique identifier for each combination of virus-host-sample within a study. The identifier is composed of a prefix, pmid, and a seven digit identifier.

study.description: An abbreviated citation for the study in the format Last name of first author, et al. Year Journal

pmid.description: A unique integer used to identify works within the PubMed system. Not to be confused with a PubMed Central Identifier. See https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/about/public-access-info/ for additional details. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0001617 for definition.

doi.description: A centrally registered identifier symbol used to uniquely identify objects given by International DOI Foundation. The DOI system is particularly used for electronic documents such as journal articles. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0002110.

vector.description: The Linnaean classification of the vector on which the experiment was performed, reported as a species binomial. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName

vectorSubspecies.description: Vector subspecies.  A taxonomic category below that of species. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C62700.

vectorStrain.description: Vector strain. A genetic variant within a species. See https://w3id.org/evorao/strain.

vectorOriginCountry.description: The country that is the wild source for original vector collection. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/country

vectorOriginLocality.description: The location that is the wild source for original vector collection. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality

vectorOriginYear.description: The year when the wild source for original vector collection occurred. May also include season or other date information. Must contain a four digit year. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/year

vectorGeneration.description: Vector generation in lab colony. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PCO_0000054

virus.description: The Linnaean classification of the virus with which the experiment was performed, reported as a species binomial. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName

viralLineage.description: Information about the genetic distinctness of the sequenced organism below the subspecies level, e.g., serovar, serotype, biotype, ecotype, or any relevant genetic typing schemes. See https://w3id.org/mixs/0000020

viralStrain.description: Identifier given to a genetic variant within a single species. See https://w3id.org/evorao/strain

viralGenBankAccession.description: Accession number of an entry from the GenBank sequence database. See http://edamontology.org/data_2292

recombinantVirus.description: Is the virus derived from recombinant nucleic acid?

wildtype.description: Is the virus unmodified (true) or has the genetic sequence of the virus been intentionally altered (false)? http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000480

Viral origin locality.description: The location that is the wild source for original virus collection. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality

Viral origin year.description: The year when the wild source for original virus collection occurred. May also include season or other date information. Must contain a four digit year. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/year

Viral history passage.description: Cell type and passage number. See https://w3id.org/evorao/passage
examples: Ae. triseriatus and Vero 12 alternate passages

Viral history freshness.description: Specifies the conditions under which the product was stored to maintain stability and integrity, such as temperature, buffer, and other environmental factors. See https://w3id.org/evorao/storageConditions

Host exposure.description: Host species used for live animal exposure. See https://w3id.org/mixs/0001298

Host lineage / origin.description: Host intraspecific lineage name, or origin. See https://w3id.org/mixs/0000020

Diagnostic (virem.).description: Diagnostic method used, if any, for measuring host viremia. See http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/D019411

Titer.description: Concentration of virus in bloodmeal, intrathoracic inoculation or host viremia if live animal. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/VO_0000555

Titer units.description: Unit of measure for titer concentration. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C67375

Dose.description: Dose of live virus injected via intrathoracic inoculation, if applicable. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25488

Dose Units.description: Unit of measure for the dose. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C48463

Mean temp. ºC (reared).description: Average temperature recorded during rearing in celsius. See http://www.ebi.ac.uk/efo/EFO_0001702

Ampliture temp. ºC (reared).description: Ampliture of temperature at which vectors are reared in Celsius. See http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000492

Mean temp. ºC (eit).description: Average temperature at which extrinsic incubation happens in Celsius. See http://www.ebi.ac.uk/efo/EFO_0001702

Ampliture temp. ºC (eit).description: Ampliture of temperature at which extrinsic incubation happens in Celsius. See http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000492

Coinfected?.description: Is your mosquito knowingly infected with another organism. See http://www.ebi.ac.uk/efo/EFO_0010716

Sample.description: Vector sample part used to establish infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100051

Diagnostic.description: How vector infection was established. See http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/D019411

# tested.description: Number of vectors tested for infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463

# positive.description: Number of vectors tested for infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463
